summary: Apache-Sitgreaves tower built 1966 per NHLR: 100-ft Aermotor 1040 with 7x7 cab, USFS-administered, registered 2009; listed standing; no staffing or access data.

facts.design: Aermotor 1040 tower, 100 ft, with 7x7-ft metal cab and catwalk to a side door
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Black Mesa Ranger District cooperator)

events.note: NHLR Built field gives 1966; no builder named
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register on September 2, 2009 as US 828, AZ 75

notes_for_editor: A hiker trip report in search results (hikearizona.com) says a locked chain-link fence blocks the tower. That page returned HTTP 403 to fetch_text and WebFetch, so the claim is unverified and not used. Another unverified search claim about private ranch land near Chevelon Butte is also not used. The standing label rests on the FFLA list, which carries no date. NHLR gives no current condition. Access is left unset. The 1966 build and Aermotor 1040 model come from NHLR alone. No staffing, fire or Forest Service record was found.
